snippet.title: Necrotyper Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Necrotyper is an action/adventure typing game with elements of RPG and strategy. You lead an undead army, which you have no direct control over. Instead, you type different spells to boost it. You have to type fast or you'll get overrun by enemies. But accuracy matters as well. Your spells will grow stronger if you don't make mistakes, which will give you the necessary edge in the battles. Spells can be upgraded so you can stand a chance against ever-increasing number of enemies.

Website: https://necrotyper.com/
Wishlist our game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228460
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/2RPUZf9nAC
